intro: A fun 10-minute journey around Kerala, India and the world. Tap, explore, then take the Daily Brain Spark quiz!

slides.title: A big healthcare project in Kozhikode
slides.summary: Kerala is moving ahead with a major organ-transplant institute at Chevayur, Kozhikode.
slides.fun: Why is this cool? One centre can bring many transplant services, training and research together.

slides.title: Keeping medicines available
slides.summary: Kerala’s Health Department is setting up district-level teams to check medicine availability in government hospitals.
slides.fun: The teams will check real stock, look for shortages and help move extra supplies where they are needed.

slides.title: AIIMS in Kerala is still a big topic
slides.summary: The question of where an AIIMS should be located in Kerala remains under discussion, with different locations being proposed.
slides.fun: AIIMS stands for All India Institute of Medical Sciences — a major public healthcare institution.

slides.title: India wins Asian Games cricket gold!
slides.summary: India defeated Pakistan by 19 runs in the men’s T20 cricket final and retained the Asian Games gold medal.
slides.fun: India made 211/6. Abhishek Sharma scored 61 and Tilak Varma made an unbeaten 51.

people.name: Narendra Modi
people.bio: Narendra Modi is the Prime Minister of India. He took office for a third term on 9 June 2024.
people.why: He congratulated the Indian men’s cricket team after its Asian Games gold-medal win.

slides.title: Karnataka is facing a serious drought
slides.summary: Karnataka is dealing with severe drought conditions, and leaders are asking the Centre for help.
slides.fun: Drought means there is much less water than usual for a long time — affecting people, farms and animals.
slides.source: Kerala PSC Current Affairs Brief, 4 Oct 2026

slides.title: Rajasthan gets a new election date
slides.summary: Rajasthan Panchayat elections are scheduled to begin on 23 October, in four phases.
slides.fun: Panchayats are local self-government bodies that help manage villages and local development.
slides.source: Kerala PSC Current Affairs Brief, 4 Oct 2026

slides.title: Germany’s leader visits Kyiv
slides.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv and announced more support for Ukraine as the war continues.
slides.fun: Germany announced a package including military and energy support and plans for closer drone cooperation.

people.name: Friedrich Merz
people.bio: Friedrich Merz is the Federal Chancellor, or head of Germany’s federal government. He has served as Chancellor since 6 May 2025.
people.why: He visited Kyiv and announced support for Ukraine in today’s story.

slides.title: Brazil votes in a major election
slides.summary: Brazil is holding a closely watched presidential election, with voters choosing the country’s next direction.
slides.fun: Brazil is the largest country in South America and one of the world’s biggest democracies.

slides.title: The Asian Games come to an end
slides.summary: The Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games concluded after two weeks of competition involving thousands of athletes.
slides.fun: The Games featured 469 gold-medal events and new sports such as padel and surfing.

quiz.q: In which Kerala city is the new comprehensive organ-transplant institute being developed?
quiz.why: The institute is at Chevayur in Kozhikode.

quiz.q: What will Kerala’s new medicine-monitoring teams check?
quiz.why: The teams will check stock, shortages, demand and supply problems.

quiz.q: Which country did India defeat in the Asian Games men’s cricket final?
Rajasthan Panchayat elections are scheduled to begin on which date?
quiz.why: The four-phase election process begins on 23 October.

quiz.q: Which German leader visited Kyiv on 4 October 2026?
quiz.why: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv.

quiz.q: Where were the 2026 Asian Games held?
quiz.why: The Games were hosted in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan.
